walletIntegrity.wonCash: Stake returned to balance, profit credited to winnings; Ledger Credit equals gross payout.
walletIntegrity.wonBonus: Profit credited to bonus; stake NOT returned; Ledger Credit equals profit.
walletIntegrity.lost: Zero wallet credit, zero ledger credit.
walletIntegrity.void: Stake returned to cash balance; locked restored; Ledger Credit equals stake.
walletIntegrity.transactionAtomicity: All ledger entries, wallet mutations, and bet status changes commit in a single SQL transaction.
